title: The autonomy dials
message: Four function modes, targets and cadence, one full-autonomy switch that remembers your dials, and a global pause
audience: Admins deciding how much the engine does unattended

scenes.headline: The autonomy *dials.*
scenes.sub: Function modes, targets, full autonomy, global pause.
scenes.narration: Settings, then Automation, is where you decide how much the engine does on its own. This video covers the four function modes, the targets and cadence, the full autonomy switch, the global pause, running the loop by hand, and the social idea gate.

scenes.headline: Manual. Assisted. *Auto.*
scenes.narration: Four functions, each with its own mode: ideation, drafting, social and publishing. Manual: the AI acts only when you click. Assisted: it runs, then queues at a human checkpoint. Auto: unattended. They are independent. A common setup is ideation and drafting on auto, social on assisted, publishing on manual. Start low, and raise a dial once you trust what arrives at review.

callouts.label: Assisted
callouts.title: Runs, then queues at a human checkpoint

scenes.headline: An empty Approved column beats any *dial.*
scenes.narration: Targets and cadence: articles per week and the publish day, social posts per week, SEO on every draft, auto-image, evergreen recycling, and a daily generation budget. Remember the engine only drafts approved ideas, so an empty Approved column means no new articles, however high the target.
scenes.spoken: Targets and cadence: articles per week and the publish day, social posts per week, S E O on every draft, auto-image, evergreen recycling, and a daily generation budget. Remember the engine only drafts approved ideas, so an empty Approved column means no new articles, however high the target.

callouts.text: The engine only drafts approved ideas.

scenes.headline: It remembers what you *had.*
scenes.narration: Full autonomy is one switch. It sets every function to auto, turns queue-on-approval on, and remembers what you had, so switching it off restores your previous dials exactly. Under it, the app presses the review buttons a person would: it approves its own ideas, clears what it can, and only holds what it genuinely cannot fix. It does not lower what the gates check.

callouts.label: One switch
callouts.title: Every function → auto · queue on approval → on · old dials remembered

callouts.text: It does not lower what the gates check.

scenes.chapter: 04 · Global pause and Run cycle now
scenes.headline: The emergency *brake.*
scenes.narration: Global pause is the emergency brake: every AI action stops, manual clicks included, until you release it. Run cycle now runs one sweep immediately; watch Drafts and the Inbox afterwards. An idle sweep is silent by design; other activity, like analytics syncs, shows the scheduler is alive. Every thirty minutes the sweep runs on its own.

callouts.label: Global pause
callouts.title: Every AI action stops, manual clicks included

scenes.headline: A social post starts as an *idea.*
scenes.narration: A social post starts as an idea. Each sweep ideates per Topic, and from a published article's angles, then a gate decides. On auto, the engine approves its own social ideas in the same sweep and drafts one approved idea per sweep, inside the weekly quota. On human, they wait on the Ideas board for you. A person's own ideas always wait for that person.

callouts.label: Gate: auto
callouts.title: The engine approves its own ideas in the same sweep

callouts.label: Gate: human
callouts.title: They wait on the board for you

scenes.headline: Settings → Automation says *which.*
scenes.narration: If nothing is being drafted, it is one of four things. The Approved column is empty. The weekly target or the daily budget is reached. Drafting is on manual. Or global pause is on. Settings, Automation, says which.

scenes.line: Start low. *Raise when you trust it.*
scenes.narration: Modes, targets, one switch and a brake. Next: measuring results.
